features.headline: Ontario nearly replaced the Skyway with three tunnels.

visuals.note: The bridge scene and the unbuilt three-tunnel alternative are separate concepts. The lower section is not a claim that tunnels exist beneath the Skyway.

The 1982 proposal and present-day arrangement share an approximate viewpoint. The Toronto Star archive image was a geometry reference and is not reproduced. Markers are explanatory, not survey positions.
